stories.title: Cisco Patches Actively Exploited ASA and FTD VPN Flaw That Can Crash Firewalls
stories.summary: Cisco has released patches to address a high-severity security flaw in Secure Firewall Adaptive Security Appliance (ASA) Software and Secure Firewall Threat Defense (FTD) Software that it said has been exploited in the wild. stories.title: CISA Adds Actively Exploited GitLab RCE and Cisco Firewall DoS Flaws to KEV
stories.summary: The U.S. Cybersecurity and Infrastructure Security Agency (CISA) on Thursday added two security flaws impacting Cisco and GitLab software to its Known Exploited Vulnerabilities (KEV), citing evidence of active exploitation. stories.title: Drupal Commerce Core Vulnerability Exploited Against Online Stores
stories.summary: Drupal says a highly critical Commerce Core access bypass is exploited in the wild and urges store owners to audit their orders.

stories.title: Drupal warns of critical Commerce Core flaw exploited in attacks
stories.summary: Drupal warned admins to patch a critical access bypass vulnerability in the Commerce Core module that attackers are exploiting in the wild.

stories.title: China-Linked Hackers Exploited VMware ESX Zero-Day to Reduce Audit Trail Visibility
stories.summary: The U.S. Cybersecurity and Infrastructure Security Agency (CISA) on Wednesday added a security flaw impacting Broadcom VMware ESX to its Known Exploited Vulnerabilities (KEV) catalog, after CrowdStrike revealed that it had been weaponized by a China-nexus threat actor known as Warp Panda in attacks targeting the U.S. legal sector. stories.title: Japan Airlines suffers third-party data breach exposing passenger info
stories.summary: Japan Airlines (JAL) has announced that a data breach at Amadeus's Passenger Service System exposed the data of about 92,000 customers.

stories.title: Hackers Actively Exploit Highly Critical Drupal Commerce Core Authorization Bypass Flaw
stories.summary: Drupal has warned that threat actors are exploiting a "highly critical" security flaw in its Commerce Core component. The vulnerability, tracked as CVE-2026-118539 (CVSS score: N/A), is a case of missing authorization affecting Commerce Core versions from 0.0.0 to 2.41 and from 3.0.0 to 3.3.13. stories.title: Binance Suffers Security Breach Affecting $6.3 Billion in Assets, Nearly $3 Billion Frozen
stories.summary: Cryptocurrency giant Binance said on Thursday that a "security incident" on its platform has impacted about $6.3 billion worth of assets. The world's biggest cryptocurrency exchange said nearly $3 billion of those assets have been frozen on-chain so far.
